paragraphs: The Champi Warrior brings the Inca army into close combat with a mace and shield. In Age of Empires, this swift infantry line fills the roles of scout and raider, threatening exposed enemies across the battlefield.
Champi Warriors can build outposts and put pressure on foot archers, siege weapons and buildings. Their mobility helps them close the distance, but cavalry can punish them in a direct fight.
Inca upgrades improve their protection. These equal-resource battles test how far that combination of speed and resilience can take them.
